name: com.oreethehat.easy-combat
description: Modular data-driven stats, health, damage, defenses, statuses and abilities for Unity.

samples.description: Piercing hitscan, explosive fireball with a burning field, and cone attacks against targets with different defenses. Requires EasyCombat 0.7.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Shooter, swept melee, pooled projectile volleys and poison combinations with bounded presentation. Requires EasyCombat 0.7.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Ten editable attack recipes and a ready-to-play firing range. Requires EasyCombat 0.7.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Health and presentation feedback through optional player-aware context providers. Requires EasyCombat 0.7.0+, EasyFeedbacks 1.8.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.

Combat slows, movement restrictions and knockback/pull for the EasyMovement FPS player, with a local prefab builder. Requires EasyCombat 0.7.0+, EasyMovement 5.1.0+, ECM2 (separate installation; tested with 1.4.3). No prerequisite sample imports.
One EasyResources wallet for ability, beam and block costs. Requires EasyCombat 0.7.0+, EasyResources 0.3.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
